classification: preregistered bounded capture_backdrop selected-region decoding and primary-vertex replay; not a public-state crop policy or unseen geometry transfer

openedOperandEvidence.correction: The frozen operand gate incorrectly required a nonzero transform pointer and mislabeled the affine-adjusted values as primary positions. The opened path uses a nonzero shape pointer and a null transform pointer in every record. The floor/ceil values are the primary positions; the residual/inverse-scale identity branch produces the primary source coordinates. This correction is retrospective and does not convert the failed workflow into a prospective pass.

regionDecoder.packed: When handle bit zero is one, signed X and Y are bits 48..63 and 32..47; width is low-word bits 17..31 and height is bits 2..16.
regionDecoder.pointer: Start from the zero iterator, follow the observed nested type-two entries and interval progression, and execute calls until the modeled post-call offset and interval index equal the captured state; each call reads Y, the variable bottom index, X, and right in the pinned instruction order.
regionDecoder.result: Replay the iterator through the captured post-call state to identify the emitted X, Y, right-minus-X, and bottom-minus-Y rectangle. On the null-transform/nonzero-shape branch, intersect it with the four signed origin-bound words exactly as the opened SIMD instructions do before comparing SP+0x280.

primaryVertexArithmetic: Convert the selected rectangle bounds to binary32 and multiply by the binary32 context scale.
Apply frintm to lower bounds and frintp to upper bounds; these four rounded values become the four primary position pairs.
Use fused fmsub for the scale-rounding residuals, binary32 division for inverse scale, and the observed identity or affine branch to produce the four primary source pairs.
Compare all position and source components as integer binary32 bit patterns without tolerance.
limitations: Decoding the selected private region and its opened intersection proves which rectangle Apple consumed, not why upstream CoreAnimation selected or constructed that region.
The renderer and owner-region fields are bounded diagnostics for post-opening mapping; no guessed semantic beyond the disassembled reads is an acceptance condition.
The earlier selection flag at SP+0x1c0 is overwritten by a rounded vertex coordinate before the 0x2b58 hook and is deliberately not captured.
The frame and object offsets are valid only while the pinned capture_backdrop and ShapeIterator prefixes remain exact.

frozenQuestion.objective: For all 114 unchanged sample-31 interventions, capture the exact selected-region handle consumed by capture_backdrop, replay ShapeIterator through its captured post-call state and the opened bounds intersection, and require the consumed rectangle plus both primary vertex fields to match bit for bit.
frozenQuestion.selectionRule: Retain at most one schema-2 operand record per selected render, only from fragment A2Xghfc vertex-buffer index 1 with the exact capture_backdrop return PC 0x2b58.
frozenQuestion.stackRule: Derive current SP as x29 - 0xa50 only after pinning the full capture_backdrop prefix and prologue. Retain the selected handle at SP+0x2a0, post-first-iterate state at SP+0x3c0, renderer pointer at SP+0x228, and the already opened rectangle, pointer, origin, affine, and context fields.
frozenQuestion.memoryRule: For an even nonzero selected-region handle, retain exactly 256 checked same-task bytes starting at the handle. For an immediate odd handle retain zero pointee bytes and decode the handle itself. Also retain only the two owner handles, all sixteen signed origin-bound bytes, eight renderer-scale bytes, and sixteen renderer region-control bytes. Any required missing or partial read fails closed.
frozenQuestion.matrixRule: Repeat the unchanged 114-record schema-4 sample-31 unit/repeat matrix as outer schema 6; do not alter geometry, requested state, filter inputs, producer input, retry policy, or capture order.
frozenQuestion.replayRule: Independently execute the exact 1 KiB ShapeIterator prefix until its post-call state equals the captured iterator, apply the opened signed-32-bit bounds intersection when selected, require the resulting rectangle to equal SP+0x280, and replay the observed primary position and source instruction order by binary32 bit pattern.
frozenQuestion.nullOutcome: A missing operand, changed code prefix, wrong PC, incomplete read mask, empty or undecodable region, out-of-bounds region word, region/rectangle mismatch, or one differing primary position or source bit fails the workflow and remains evidence.

analysisPlan.regionInventory: After opening, group exact selected handles, decoded rectangles, owner handles, renderer controls, and requested target-center coordinates without fitting per-record cases.
analysisPlan.policyMapping: Trace each selected handle back through the pinned region-selection branches and test one public-state-only construction rule against every opened record.
analysisPlan.nextGate: Only after public inputs reproduce every selected rectangle and primary vertex bit may that rule be frozen against distinct native geometries and temporal states.
analysisPlan.qualityRule: No diagnostic result authorizes a production shader edit, approximation, or quality tradeoff.
